exposure: SB patients with and without hydrocephalus
SB patients with and without Chiari malformation
SB patients with Chiari malformation type 1 (CM-1) or type 2 (CM-2)
cohort: Pregnant women with and without spina bifida (SB)
finding: Pregnant women with SB were significantly more likely to undergo cesarean delivery and experience peripartum complications, including seizures and VTE, compared to pregnant women without SB.
mod_finding: SB patients were significantly more likely to undergo cesarean delivery (1.200; 95% CI [1.133-1.271]) and less likely to receive neuraxial analgesia (0.406; 95% CI [0.383-0.431]).
